dimensions.assessment: Involves federal real estate experts, private commercial real estate experts, state experts, and federal agency personnel undergoing relocation or consolidation.
dimensions.evidence: include experts related to private commercial real estate; experts related to Federal real estate; and if available, State... real estate experts

dimensions.assessment: Aims to alter how public buildings are financed, constructed, and disposed of to reduce federal costs and improve space utilization.
dimensions.evidence: identify alternative financing solutions for the construction or renovation of public buildings... that will reduce costs to the Federal Government

dimensions.assessment: Intended to reduce federal building costs through alternative financing and asset disposal, but gives no specific dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: reduce costs to the Federal Government

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new planning, reporting, consultation, and web publishing requirements on the GSA regarding public-private partnerships.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of General Services shall convene consultation meetings to identify alternative financing solutions... and submit to the President

dimensions.assessment: Requires initial meetings and reports within specific short-term deadlines (90 and 120 days), with ongoing website transparency and milestone tracking.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Administrator... shall convene

missing_information: Specific names or locations of federal buildings and projects initially selected for the recommended list
Total projected financial savings to the federal government
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the GSA to hold consultation meetings, develop alternative financing recommendations, and publish a list of public building projects using public-private partnerships to reduce federal costs.
